meta.title: Your Vancouver Starter Guide | Zippling
meta.description: A complete guide for newcomers to Vancouver, from renting and shopping to banking and finding work.

GuidesPage.intro1: I remember when I first arrived in Vancouver, all by myself, ready to start a new chapter. It was exciting, but also a bit overwhelming. I quickly learned that the more I knew about the city, the more comfortable and at home I felt. I spent countless hours gathering information, figuring things out one step at a time.
GuidesPage.intro2: This guide is built on the very lessons my friends and I learned along the way. We've been in your shoes. Our hope is that by sharing our collective experience, we can make your transition into this beautiful city a little smoother and help you avoid the same hurdles we faced. Welcome to your new beginning.
